matter_background.original: In 1995 Shantha Silva purchased a land in extent of 10 perches situated in Kalutara for Rs.700,000/- and constructed a house on it. The cost of construction of the house was Rs.2,000,000/-. He wishes to gift this house and land to his daughter Sumana and he instructs you to prepare a Deed of Gift in this regard. The present market value of the house and property is Rs.10,400,000/-.

questions.source_quote:
(4) In 1995 Shantha Silva purchased a land in extent of 10 perches situated in Kalutara
for Rs.700,000/- and constructed a house on it. The cost of construction of the
house was Rs.2,000,000/-. He wishes to gift this house and land to his daughter
Sumana and he instructs you to prepare a Deed of Gift in this regard. The present
market value of the house and property is Rs.10,400,000/-. Calculate the stamp
duty payable on this Deed of Gift and explain the procedure. You must show the
method of calculating the stamp duty.
